verdict.rationale: BugSnag's releases documentation says stack traces will link directly to the line of code, but only on some platforms. Nothing in the pack shows suspect-commit identification, code-owner surfacing, or an explicit repository connection that resolves lines on the default branch. Missing for 10: suspect commits on issues, code owners on issues, documented repo/SCM integration setup, confirmation that links target the exact line on the default branch, broad platform coverage for source linking, independent or hands-on corroboration.
